title: Aureline M5 cohort-evidence packet
description: Canonical per-domain evidence packet minted by the first implement lane over the frozen M5 launch-control matrix. Names the evidence scope a launch-bearing lane resolves its cohort proof from — internal dogfood-ring telemetry, current rehearsal cadence, or an explicit go/no-go signoff — and binds the resolved cohort identity, the known-limits ledger, the rollback-target reference, the rehearsal-currency state, the readiness-signoff state, the cohort-bound partner / public support-language reference, and the last widening revision so claim publication can prove which cohort evidence backs each launch-bearing lane, partner / public support language stays bound to that proof rather than to hand-edited prose, and a known-limits gap is flagged rather than masquerading as covered. Downstream shiproom, release-center, executive-steering, program-governance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a cohort's backing evidence by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
